headline.purpose: Every section H2: 2.25rem to 3.5rem at md, one italic stressed word.

statement.purpose: The single thesis paragraph, 1.75rem to 2.6rem at md, inks in as read.

title.purpose: Hairline-grid cell titles and sound-pair glyphs (serif 2xl light).

lede.purpose: Paragraph beside a headline, ink-2; 1.25rem in the hero at md.

body.purpose: Cell bodies and FAQ answers, ink-2, max 60ch.

control.purpose: Download button, install steps, language line (15px).

label.purpose: Section labels: Geist Mono 11px uppercase 0.12em, ink-2. Deliberate spec-sheet part labels (Saturn reference).

script.purpose: Text inside the notch panel, from the app's Classic constants (16px, 1.55).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The house curve: word rise, reveals, voice-panel line shift, screen-share transitions, FAQ plus, download icon.

motion.name: tn-word / tn-rise
motion.value: 900ms ease-out-expo, from opacity 0, translateY(0.35em), blur(8px); delay 450ms + i*55ms
motion.purpose: Focal: hero headline reads itself in word by word; lede and button rise on the same timeline.

motion.name: ink-in
motion.value: per word opacity 0.2 -> 1 as the paragraph moves from 85% to 45% of the viewport (150ms opacity transition)
motion.purpose: Focal: the statement inks in as it is read. Server-rendered fully inked.

motion.name: data-reveal

motion.name: notch-spring

motion.name: tn-classic-scroll
motion.purpose: Teleprompter script scroll at the app's constant speed.

motion.name: voice-tracking
motion.purpose: Voice panel lights the spoken word, only while on screen.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no word rise, scroll, wave, ink-in, auto-toggle or tracking; reveals become 300ms linear opacity; spring lands in one frame

narrative.northStar: The Page Proof Under the Notch
narrative.overview:
The page is a proof sheet: warm paper inside one framed column with hairline rails and crop marks at every section seam. A light Newsreader serif carries the voice, Geist the prose, Geist Mono the machine (labels, facts, keys, the script). Black is the notch's material: a real menu bar and the live notch are pinned to the top, and the page closes with the same panel opened all the way. Rose means recording.

Motion follows the teleprompter: the hero reads itself in word by word and the statement inks in as it scrolls through the viewport. Supporting motion (reveals, screen-share toggle, voice tracking, waveform) pauses offscreen, and every effect has a reduced-motion path.
keyCharacteristics: One framed column (max 72rem) between hairline rails, crop marks at every section seam.
Light serif (300) for all headlines, one italic word as the stress.
Mono uppercase labels name sections like a spec sheet.
Hairline grids from a 1px gap over the rule colour.
Black is the notch; rose is recording; blue is focus.
Text inks in as it is read; loops pause offscreen.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Black is the notch, rose is recording, blue is focus. Rose on anything else breaks the vocabulary.

rules.name: The Ink Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from ink vs. ink-2 vs. ink-3, never from an accent, tinted band or gradient on UI.

rules.name: The Light Voice Rule
rules.body: Every serif headline is weight 300 with negative tracking. No bold serif, no sans headline.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: A headline may italicise one stressed word, never a phrase.

rules.name: The Spec Sheet Label Rule
rules.body: Sections are named by an 11px mono uppercase label above the H2: a deliberate page-proof choice (Saturn reference), a part name, never a teaser.

rules.name: The Rails Rule
rules.body: Content lives between the rails; full-bleed within the frame, never past it.

rules.name: The Gap Is The Line Rule
rules.body: Grid lines are the 1px gap showing the rule through, not card borders.

rules.name: The Flush Notch Rule
rules.body: The notch panel and the closing band are never lifted, outlined or shadowed.

rules.name: The Read-Along Rule
rules.body: Focal motion is text being read, in reading order; other motion demonstrates the product.

rules.name: The Offscreen Stop Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates where it cannot be seen, and nothing but opacity animates under reduced motion.

dos: Do keep every section inside the railed frame, with a top hairline and crop marks at the rail seams.
Do set every headline in Newsreader 300 with negative tracking and at most one italic word.
Do name sections with the 11px mono uppercase label, as a spec-sheet part name.
Do draw grids as a 1px gap over the rule colour.
Do build illustrations from TopNotch's own UI and the app's ported constants, unchanged.
Do keep one action, "Download for Mac", identical wherever it appears.
Do pause every loop offscreen and give every effect a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't use rose for anything but recording or capture.
Don't shadow, outline or lift the notch panel or the closing band.
Don't introduce icon cards, badge rows, gradient CTAs, or a second accent colour.
Don't set headlines in Geist or in a bold serif.
Don't round bands, grid cells or strips; rounding is for pills, keys and the notch.
Don't let autoplay motion start before the visitor can see it, or keep it running after they scroll past.
